title: WebSocket client hook for video feed and telemetry state synchronization
description: Implement web/src/hooks/useCameraStream.js managing WebSocket connection to /ws/stream with automatic reconnection, frame rate tracking, telemetry state parsing, and connection status reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Connects to backend WebSocket and updates latest video frame base64 URL
Parses incoming telemetry (eye closure probability, blink rate, alert stage, FPS, latency)
Handles network disconnection with exponential backoff and sets connection state to disconnected
Cleans up WebSocket connection when component unmounts
Unit tests verify WebSocket message parsing and event callbacks

steps.details: Create web/src/hooks/useCameraStream.js with states: isConnected, frameData, telemetry, error, and connect/disconnect methods.

steps.description: Implement message handling and state updates
steps.details: On message: parse JSON payload, set frameData with image JPEG URL, set telemetry state with closed_prob, bpm, stage, fps.
When socket closes unexpectedly: schedule reconnect attempt with 1s, 2s, 4s delay up to 5 attempts.

steps.description: Write unit tests for hook with mock WebSocket
steps.details: Create web/src/hooks/__tests__/useCameraStream.test.js with vitest verifying telemetry update upon received socket event.

technicalNotes: Avoid React re-render thrashing: throttle state updates to frame arrival cadence.
Revoke previous object URLs or manage base64 image strings cleanly to prevent memory bloat.
